reviews.review_description: Amazing VR experience! The graphics look great, the gameplay is fun and immersive, and the mixed reality features make the zombies feel like they’re actually in your environment. The controls are smooth and the game is really enjoyable. Definitely worth trying for anyone who enjoys zombie survival games!

developer_response.body: Thank you for the great feedback! We're glad you enjoyed the mixed reality experience. We appreciate your suggestion and will work on adding more zombies! 🧟

reviews.review_description: The gun feels like a real gun. The shooting, aim, reloading, handling, everything is just perfect. Two modes add depth to the game and tutorial makes the game easy to understand.

developer_response.body: Thank you for your feedback! We're glad you enjoyed the realistic gun mechanics and gameplay experience.

reviews.review_description: Looks very realistic noticing zombies teleport in your living room. overall nice experience

developer_response.body: Thank you! We're glad you enjoyed the realistic mixed reality experience of zombies appearing in your living room! 🧟
